findings.what: README says '`nvm use 22`, which reads `.nvmrc`'. That is wrong: `nvm use 22` takes an explicit version and ignores .nvmrc (it picks the newest installed 22.x, which could be below 22.18); only a bare `nvm use` reads .nvmrc (root .nvmrc = 22.18.0, found from be/ or web/ by walking up). The script has the same ambiguity ('le depot contient .nvmrc : nvm use 22'). Works on this machine only because the sole installed 22.x is v22.23.2 (~/.nvm/versions/node). The hard-coded PATH example is machine-specific but labelled as an example. The mandatory `node -v` check after it makes the failure visible, so P3.
findings.suggested_fix: Write 'nvm use (no argument: reads .nvmrc)' or 'nvm install 22.18 && nvm use 22.18'.

findings.what: The docs say that on Node 18 `npm start` / `npm run seed:demo` fail with `node: bad option: --env-file-if-exists=.env` (alternative `--disable-warning=...` in parentheses). Because `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` comes first on the command line, the message actually printed on Node 18.20.7 is `node: bad option: --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` (and seed:demo has no --env-file flag at all, so it can only show that one). The text is hedged with 'ou', but the lead example is the one that does not appear. The practical advice ('if you see bad option, it is the Node version') is correct.
findings.evidence: Ran with Node 18: `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --env-file-if-exists=.env -e 0` -> 'bad option: --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning'; `node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e 0` -> '--env-file-if-exists=.env'. be/package.json start/seed:demo scripts.
findings.suggested_fix: Put `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` first, or say 'node: bad option: --...'.

findings.what: The runbook copies be/.env.example to .env, whose AUTH_SECRET is blank. app.ts uses `env.AUTH_SECRET || randomBytes(32)`, so every API start has a new secret. Plan B says 'relancez l'API, puis cliquez Retry': the old guest token will then be invalid and the app (App.tsx recovery) opens a new guest session with the notice 'Your guest session expired, so a new guest session was opened. Unsaved progress on the previous one is not shown here.' The script does not warn the presenter about this notice or about losing the in-progress mission. From code reading only (servers not run).
findings.evidence: be/src/app.ts configFromEnv secret line; be/.env.example AUTH_SECRET=; web/src/App.tsx:70-71.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one sentence to Plan B: after an API restart a notice 'Your guest session expired' is expected; or set a fixed AUTH_SECRET in the runbook for demos.
